rootCause.classification: macOS debugger attach permission is disabled in the host environment
directEvidence: LLDB process launch failed with 'attach failed (Not allowed to attach to process)'.
A real `dlv dap` 1.27.2 session received initialize, accepted launch, built the Go test package and started the LLDB debugserver helper, but the helper never completed its attach handshake.
Because Delve had not yet sent initialized/launch responses, the native debug UI correctly remained at the Launching program step rather than pretending tests had started.

reproduction.fixture: A disposable Go test package under /private/tmp with one passing test.
reproduction.residualProcesses: Only probe-owned debugserver/dlv processes were terminated after their exact paths and start times were checked.

rootCause.environmentRemediation: Run `sudo DevToolsSecurity -enable` in Terminal and complete the administrator authentication. The IDE cannot and must not collect the administrator password.

preflight.behavior: Before Delve starts on a non-headless macOS host, verify DevToolsSecurity status and fail with an actionable message instead of waiting indefinitely.
preflight.managedComputerGuidance: Ask the machine administrator to allow developer tools when policy prevents enabling it.

processOwnership.behavior: For launch sessions, observe descendants under the exact Delve adapter and retain PID, start timestamp and ancestry depth. After bounded shutdown, reap only those identity-matched descendants, deepest first.
processOwnership.attachBoundary: Go Attach and remote attach keep descendant tracking disabled so a user-owned debuggee is never killed when the adapter detaches.
processOwnership.pidReuseGuard: A current process is signalled only when its start instant matches the process observed under this adapter.

verification.covered: A launch adapter's child and grandchild are reaped while an unrelated process launched from the same executable remains alive.
verification.existingCompatibility: GoAttachedAdapterLifecycleTest continues to prove attach descendants are not reaped; GoLaunchedAdapterLifecycleTest and GoTestDapPreconnectLifecycleTest cover native Stop and DAP lifecycle behavior.

releaseDecision.reason: The source-level fixes are not yet proven by a real macOS debug session because this host requires an administrator to enable Developer Mode. Publishing would overstate runtime compatibility.
